items.title: 十二怒汉
items.creator: Sidney Lumet
items.note: 一间屋、十二把椅子、一场关于合理怀疑的陪审团辩论——单场景电影的天花板。
items.noteEn: One room, twelve men, one argument for reasonable doubt — the ceiling of single-set cinema.

items.title: 教父
items.creator: Francis Ford Coppola
items.note: 家族即系统：忠诚、背叛与权力继承的黑帮史诗，奠定了整个帮派片语法的地基。
items.noteEn: The family as a system: an epic of loyalty, betrayal and succession that built the mafia-film grammar.

items.title: 教父2
items.creator: Francis Ford Coppola
items.note: 双线交叉剪辑把移民血泪与家族崩塌并置，续集比肩原作的罕见样本。
items.noteEn: Dual timelines braid an immigrant's rise against a family's fall — the rare sequel that rivals the original.

items.title: 末代皇帝
items.creator: Bernardo Bertolucci
items.note: 紫禁城实景拍摄，把一个囚徒皇帝的一生拍成东方与西方眼光的对话。
items.noteEn: Shot inside the Forbidden City, a captive emperor's life becomes a dialogue between East and West.

items.title: 霸王别姬
items.creator: 陈凯歌
items.note: 戏梦人生半个世纪，把京剧国粹、性别与政治悲剧熔进一炉的华语巅峰。
items.noteEn: Half a century of opera, love and political tragedy — the pinnacle of Chinese-language cinema.

items.title: 辛德勒的名单
items.creator: Steven Spielberg
items.note: 黑白影像里那一点红衣，是人性在灰烬中仍未被抹去的证据。
items.noteEn: A single red coat in a world of black and white — proof that humanity survived the ashes.

items.title: 阿甘正传
items.creator: Robert Zemeckis
items.note: 用一颗纯真的心穿过美国半个世纪的乱流，笨拙本身就是一种幸运。
items.noteEn: Running on innocence through half a century of American chaos — simplicity as luck.

items.title: 肖申克的救赎
items.creator: Frank Darabont
items.note: 希望是好的，也许是世上最好的东西——体制化的温柔反叛。
items.noteEn: Hope is a good thing, maybe the best of things — a gentle rebellion against the system.

items.title: 活着
items.creator: 张艺谋
items.note: 一个家庭在时代洪流里反复失去，活着的意义被逼到只剩「活着」。
items.noteEn: A family stripped of everything by history, until meaning is reduced to survival itself.

items.title: 千与千寻
items.creator: 宫崎骏
items.note: 名字是身份的键——失去名字就失去对自身的引用，宫崎骏写给成长的温柔警告。
items.noteEn: A name is the key to identity — a gentle warning about growing up from Hayao Miyazaki.

items.title: 让子弹飞
items.creator: 姜文
items.note: 枪声一响、隐喻满场，张麻子与黄四郎的对弈是讲不尽的寓言。
items.noteEn: Bullets flying, allegory everywhere — Zhang's duel with Huang is an inexhaustible fable.

items.title: 模仿游戏
items.creator: Morten Tyldum
items.note: 图灵破译恩尼格玛的秘密战争，与一个天才被时代辜负的悲剧。
items.noteEn: Turing's secret war against Enigma — and a genius betrayed by the very system he saved.

items.title: 至暗时刻
items.creator: Joe Wright
items.note: 加里·奥德曼的丘吉尔，把嘴硬、焦虑与绝不投降揉进每一次呼吸。
items.noteEn: Gary Oldman's Churchill — stubbornness, anxiety and refusal to yield in every breath.
